notes.title: Update 55! 🎉
notes.notes:
[h1]Introducing "Normal Update Numbers"[/h1] I've ditched boring update names like "0.4.15v1" for something that you know, sounds like a human wrote it 😉 Like a good old regular number that corresponds with what update it is! Though I will say, I don't actually know if this is my 55th update, but it's gotta be somewhere around there, or even more (we should ask Myriad 🤷‍♂️)

[h1]State Of Warcube
[/h1]Welcome to the very first 'State Of Warcube' post. After nearly a year of no major update, I feel this is totally necessary. But before I start, I just want to say how incredibly thankful I am to every person who reached out to me on every platform (specially my Discord fam) with encouragement, kind words, and gentle prods of 'when will you update things?' as well as the ever unique 'hello?' ([b]looking at you Bup[/b]). Suffice to say it's probably easier if I give a timeline of the past year to better put things into perspective. But to be succinct for you TL;DR folks out there: I really broke the game and started also working full-time.

1. November 2018: Was working on my first boss fight and physically moving states
2. December 2018: Moved, published a beta build, and started a full-time job.
3. January-March 2019: Broke the game by upgrading unity and not backing things up, like a fool
4. April - August 2019: Patched nearly every broken scene in the game to get it where things were roughly before.
5. Sept - December 2019: Worked way through backlog of bugs amidst full-time job. Again, I really struggle with time management at this point.
6. January - February 2020: Had another kid, finished fixing the arena, publishing beta builds again.
7. Now: Published the first of many updates for the 2020 year, featuring basically everything the game had in it before, as well as a few new things ;) 

[h1]Early Access
[/h1]I've recently gone through and looked through my original Early Access descriptions on Steam (oof) and have decided I need to revamp them to better communicate my goals with the game, and my sincerity to finishing it. Everyone who knows me will understand the grit I have with finishing projects, and also my complete paralysis that comes from wanting to DO EVERYTHING ALL THE TIME. This is on my list to do for next week 😁 (good timing with your message Myriad!)So bear with me, and if my new descriptions don't fit your experience with owning the game these past few years, let me know :)

[h1]Big Stuff
[/h1]- Arena mode is back
- New start screen
- Mac version is stalled for a bit due to some new build criteria via Apple

[h1]Small Stuff
[/h1]- A million bugs have been fixed
- Slight performance improvements in large levels

[h1]How You Can Help
[/h1]I'm adding a new section to help guide all the incredibly passionate people I've met who just want to help. Sometimes this will be a useful section, other times it wont. BUT. Right now, I could REALLY use help identifying other REALLY obnoxious bugs in the game, I'm not talking about the occasional clipping through walls and stuff, more the things that happen that really ruin the game while playing it. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/505060/discussions/3/141136086936589152/]Here's some information on how to best describe a bug (to better help me fix it!).[/url] Or even just providing images and succinct descriptions is VERY helpful, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/505060/discussions/3/2639605659787242579/]similar to what Hedgie did here.[/url]

Or list some details in the #issues-and-bugs channel of the [url=discord.gg/Warcube]Discord Server.[/url] I'm a little behind on logging them just a heads up :D

[h1]Bottom Paragraph
[/h1]Oh hey! You've made it to the bottom paragraph! Boy are you in for a treat ;) this is the little section where I just say hi. To you specifically. And this time I just want to take the time to say thank you. Thank you for being patient with me, thank you for believing in me, and for really being the kind of friend, player, fam a developer really appreciates :) making Warcube has changed my life in so many ways, and being able to connect with REAL people who are REALLY passionate about life in some way, is the biggest source of encouragement to me. So hey, have a great day... OR RATHER... have a great week! Wake up tomorrow and dig into life, it's certainly strange and wonderful (even amidst The Great Plague™)

-craigz

notes.title: Belendir's Crown + Archer Update! - 0.2.3v4
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MC3qIB8.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://imgur.com/a/xlCOyh9]TL;DR GIFLOG[/url][/h1]

[h1]Belendir's Crown + Archer Update![/h1]
Introducing Belendir's Crown. A fort deep within Warling territory that was pivotal in delaying the Redkin invasion. Captain Belendir, a famous marksman, was said to have held off the enemy with his small contingent of forces for 6 days, only falling when the entire garrison had run out of ammo.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7XGQGuT.gif[/img]

[h1]Beta Feedback Info![/h1]
If you're not sure how to enable Beta Location mode, check it out [url=https://i.imgur.com/87zgmNL.gifv]HERE![/url] and be sure to send me feedback either through the feedback towers, on [url=http://discord.gg/warcube]DISCORD[/url] or via the [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScl6_0zrbhs_5tVkhI3Mw4tH36yQvMn_hgWDKTv20y-GwfmwQ/viewform]online feedback form here![/url]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/76154b1f26169971bb28f22ccf972a4bc991eb69.png[/img]
Nice to finally wrap up one of the new locations! There's a couple more coming soon too :) I've also been hard at work on siege mode, and will hope to have people testing it out soon(tm)! :P

***MAC BUILD IS USUALLY A DAY LATE, MESSAGE ME IF IT'S LATER THAN THAT***

[h1]0.2.3v4 - 06/22/2018[/h1]
-----

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/157ebd25aa857802194f155140a5793032841d08.png[/img]
[h1]New Location![/h1]
'Belendir's Crown' - formerly Hillcamp now out of Beta! :D

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Tn1Z01s.jpg[/img]

[h1]Improved Archers![/h1]

Archers are now much better at their jobs :P with improved accuracy, and the ability to now arc their projectiles :D this was all made by possible by the incredibly talented Ryan DowlingSoka, so be sure to say thanks to him on Twitter :D https://twitter.com/ryandowlingsoka

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9OdqPox.gif[/img]

[h1]Chiefs/Captains[/h1]

Introducing captains! Or errr... chiefs? I don't know, tell me what you think they should be called :P basically, kill these units and their surrounding units will be thrown into a panic. Super fun to watch :D

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VRuuW3o.gif[/img]

[h1]New Dialogue Boxes![/h1]

So I'm just starting to role these out, and will need to swap lots of the older ones. Using these will allow me to start also doing localization AND I think will just overall be better moving forward. You can press 'F' when in range to continue to the next page, or 'V' to go back :)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AVGtSs5.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/f8559ed10c9770ac0de57828b9b318145f6543f4.png[/img]

[h1]Platforming Elements[/h1]
Introducing a new sort of platforming element! I'm calling them flipboards right now, but if you have a better name/idea for how they should look, definitely give a shout :) you can find them in the new location somewhere special ;)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ciD57oC.gif[/img]

[h1]Enemy Alarm Sounders![/h1]

Enemies will now try and sound an alarm when they spot you! (if ones nearby)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XkD5cYK.gif[/img]

[h1]Barracks Doors[/h1]
In Saltpeat village you'll find a new type of enemy alarm spawner! It's a barracks door! :D these will constantly spawn units until destroyed :)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GD8DYhT.gif[/img]

[h1]Mo0r improvements[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Versioning, updated my silly versioning to something that makes more sense! :P
    [*]PLAYER, are now invincible during cinematics.
    [*]Hill Camp, NPC with dialogue + end cinematic and more set decorating.
    [*]GUI, added exit confirmation to main screen instead of auto-exit @Myriad @Dartel
    [*]AI, units that dont see you and are melee attacked will now turn to fight you! @everyone
    [*]Dynamic Battle, added grass.
    [*]Input, any button now skips intro cinematic.
    [*]Quest Manager, I started working on a quest manager, nothing visual to see yet, but soon! It's working on stuff behind the scenes ;)
    [*]Experience System, I blocked in an exp system, nothing fancy yet, but you can track your exp in the character menu!
    [*]Early Access Intro, now tracking things behind the scenes ;) 
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/2ce05ab99219d9dd463609a90ffd643d9544cd74.png[/img]
[list]
    [*]Saltpeat Village, fixed looping objective on death @Dartel @Myriad @Hat
    [*]St. Bollickus, fixed strange mausoleum door business :/ @Shermy
    [*]Personal Message Intro, fixed typo. @megzmissing/being clipped @Dartel @Hat @Myriad @Shermy
    [*]Archive, removed legacy video sign in Jerry's Gate.
    [*]Archive, removed map tutorial, getting outdated.
    [*]Shields, fixed units not being able to see you through them. @Dartel
    [*]Fire, *think* I fixed ever looping fire glitch that would occasionally crash the game D:
    [*]Input, fixed pressing the tactics key to freezing intro camera animation.
[/list]

[h1]DEBUG[/h1]
[list]
    [*]MAP - can reset individual locations from within the location menu now.
    [*]MAP - tap 'H' to get a readout of all your props current states and locations! 
    [*]MAP - prop reset *should* now work if your props were floating in Oblivion 
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/2b8f1a963a12b73f41c75a08e8121289dd991f85.png[/img]
[list]
    [*]MAP, army units clip through map.
    [*]CAM, clipping with tall structures + buildings.
    [*]Arena Mode under construction again
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/a57e8df5e05c440c963122987884a0f9283ab025.png[/img]
[spoiler]hatter[/spoiler]

[h1]Check out the #Latest-Update-Discussion on Discord and let me know what you think![/h1]

 --> discord.gg/Warcube

[h1]Bottom Paragraph![/h1] 
Well! I can't believe its already this late in June, time has been absolutely flying. I told myself I wanted to have siege mode completed by this time, and so part of me is definitely disappointed it isnt yet xD but I know I just need to keep working hard, keep adding new locations and features, fix bugs like crazy, and eventually it'll all get done :D thanks for all your patience and encouragement, it really means a ton to me :) and remember! If you still haven't rated the game, that's one of the BEST things you can do to help the game get better visibility on Steam :) so tell your friends to pick it up while it's on sale! :D

Also I got a new haircut, so uhh... I'll be wearing a hat for bit :P

notes.title: GIFlog #4 Traps, Unit Orders & Stealth Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Happy Late Update Everyone! :D[/h1]
Had a crazy weekend trying to get my builds together, after all, gotta release this month ;) so here's a quick update on things I've been doing!

[h1]Functional Traps! (stand in front of logs? You ded!)[/h1]

Worked on a system for organizing traps, so now I have trip lines and ropes and switches that all trigger different things to happen! For instance, you could have also shot the base of that rope to trigger the log trap :D

[img]http://i.imgur.com/kxEPdyJ.gif[/img]

[h1]Unit Orders! Attack, Hold Position, Go There[/h1]

New command ring! It'll highlight units currently under your command. Simple, but makes all the difference :)

[img]http://i.imgur.com/tYlkD6w.gif[/img]

Right now you can tell your units to follow you (default), attack, hold position, or tell them where to go. I want to make the orders be super fun too! So for calling for an attack, maybe your character pulls out a rams horn or something? I'm a Lord of the Rings nerd, and I just think battles should always start with a horn! :P

[img]http://i.imgur.com/oovDhRj.gif[/img]

[h1]Stealth System Update[/h1]

Guys I've just been so excited for this stealth system! Feels so strange working on things like unit orders AND stealth, then I realize. It all leads to the same glorious destruction and slow motion :P Enemies have some new features, they now..

[list]
    [*]Get suspicious of arrows and things like that and will move to investigate.
    [*]Alert others when they're attacked.
    [*]Get surprised when they see you.
    [*]Can block attacks! (been procrastinating on this, not sure why...)
[/list]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/4438mbc.gif[/img]

Still so much to do before Early Access! I finally am started to see the challenge of working on levels and locations vs. making cool features. Hopefully I find that balance soon ;) 

Have a great rest of the week friends!

don't be a stranger!
[h1]-craigz[/h1]


[img]http://i.imgur.com/pHHYdIi.gif[/img]

notes.title: Release Update Announcement!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/2ec92a0a11aa5c29c79ac40bdf4ccf4b7a58690e.gif[/img]

Hi friends! Yes that IS what I look like above ;)

I wanted to give an update on release! But before I get rolling...

[h1]TL;DR RELEASING JANUARY 2017[/h1]

Why the delay? Who am I? EA or Ubisoft?! Not at all, just me! ːsteamhappyː

It's been a wild past couple months since PAX and I've been really moving forward with the game. I can't thank you guys enough for the support :)

[h1]I had the awesome opportunity to go to Steam Dev Days a couple weeks back.[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/f4d9a2c144ccd864e4bfb6e7d3095ee5a8cb2168.jpg[/img]

While there I heard some incredible talks from people who are WAY smarter than me. They recommended to stay away from releasing anytime from October - December. Instead, continue building the game, polishing what I have and releasing after the holiday madness.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/2f4dd4abb89c3146127e309831ce6481f50c8403.jpg[/img]

[h1] And I believe that's the right thing to do :) [/h1]

So I'm going to keep drilling away on the game, adding new things and am more excited than ever to get everyone playing in January 2017 :) 

[b]What better way to start the new year out, right? [/b] ːsteamhappyː

[h1]Also I'm starting a new thing for updates![/h1]

It's called 'Community Shoutout'! Where I thank people in the community. This can come in a variety of forms: from encouragement, starting a popular discussion, even just leaving a clever comment ;) 

I'd like to have something eventually to give people IN GAME, but am not sure what yet. Just one of the small ways I want to say thank YOU! ːsteamhappyː

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25954084/fb7ad6d70e4c35e6ddad58cce3e1b5d811af4d00.jpg[/img]

I've been having so much fun making this game, lots of sleepless nights and early mornings. But couldnt be happier :D

Don't hesitate to give a shout if you have any questions or just want to say hi, I've enabled my notifications on comments, so I'll be sure to get back to you :D

-craigz
